upload_textures()

upload_textures(a, b): void;

Defined in: website/public/wasm/flag/luiskr_flag.d.ts:71

upload_textures — stage one or two RGBA8 flag images. Single- flag widgets pass rgba_b identical to rgba_a (the shader reads tex2 only when is_split=1 — a duplicate binding is the cheapest no-op). Rebuilds the bind group so the new textures go live next frame.

ImageBitmap inputs — the browser decodes the SVG off-main- thread and copyExternalImageToTexture moves pixels GPU→GPU, so no CPU pixel round-trip ever touches the flag path.

Parameters

a

ImageBitmap

The primary flag's decoded bitmap.

b

ImageBitmap

The secondary flag's decoded bitmap (same as a for unsplit locales — a duplicate binding is the cheapest no-op).

Returns

void
